title: The Tupperware Avalanche
style: comedy ska, 130 BPM, brass stabs, upstroke guitar, walking bass, snappy snare, female lead vocal with male spoken interjections, kitchen ambient SFX, theatrical exasperation, sing-along chorus, hooky
lyrics:
[Intro — cabinet creak, plastic clatter, brass stab]
You opened the cabinet
You only have yourself to blame

[Verse 1 — female, exasperated]
I asked for a small container, the kind with a lid
You opened the cupboard and the lids all hid
Three hundred bottoms came tumbling down
Not a single matching top to be found

[Pre-Chorus]
A round lid for a square base
A square lid for a round face
A lid from nineteen ninety-seven
A base from a brand that's gone to heaven

[Chorus]
The Tupperware avalanche!
The Tupperware avalanche!
Three hundred bottoms and seven good lids
The kingdom of mismatched plastic kids
The Tupperware avalanche!

[Verse 2]
I have lids that fit no container that I own
I have containers without lids alone
There's a yoghurt tub doing duty as a salad keeper
There's an ice-cream tub holding leftover sleeper

[Pre-Chorus]
The good ones, the glass ones, are precious as gems
The plastic ones outnumber my dinner-plate hems
I tried to organise it back in two thousand and twelve
By two thousand and thirteen they had reshelved themselves

[Chorus]
The Tupperware avalanche!
The Tupperware avalanche!
Three hundred bottoms and seven good lids
The kingdom of mismatched plastic kids
The Tupperware avalanche!

[Bridge — spoken, calm acceptance]
[me] I'm just gonna leave them on the floor.
[partner] You can't leave them on the floor.
[me] I will rebuild the system.
[partner] You said that in twenty-twelve.
[me] …I'll just shove them back in.
[partner] That's how we got here.

[Outro]
The Tupperware avalanche!
Every kitchen has one, every household knows
The Tupperware avalanche!
